> @gagb Would be great to have this as an example in the README! Thanks. 

 _Originally posted by @sdhutchins in [#12](https://github.com/microsoft/markitdown/issues/12#issuecomment-2542522406)_


```python
from markitdown import MarkItDown
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()
md = MarkItDown(mlm_client=client, mlm_model="gpt-4o")
image_file = 'https://gagb.github.io/imgs/bansal-chi21.png'
result = md.convert(source=image_file)
print(result.text_content)
```
title: Add model client example in docs/readme
